description: Xu Chu, huge broad-shouldered chinese warrior in the supplied pixel art style. Black hair in a topknot, a white fur collar over dark armor with gold trim, bare muscular arms with gold bracers, blue loincloth, dark boots. He holds a heavy mace: a short thick dark shaft with a big round spiked iron head
face: Fierce broad face with a thick black beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the black topknot, the white fur collar across the shoulders, the broad armored back and the blue loincloth, the mace at his right side.
guard_action: both hands take the mace and hold it in front of the body, the feet spread and the knees bend

actions.idle: Heavy fighting guard, mace held in both hands in front, breathing
actions.move: Seamless heavy combat run in place carrying the mace, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Short downward mace blow. Frames 1-5 the mace is lifted to shoulder height only; frames 6-8 a short hard blow straight down onto the target; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spiked mace stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Rising mace blow. Frames 1-6 the mace head drops low behind the body; frames 7-8 the knees straighten and the mace is swung up from below through the target; frames 9-11 the mace ends high above the head. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spiked mace stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Big circular overhead smash. Frames 1-6 the mace head drops low behind and is swung in one big circle back and up over the head; frame 8 it crashes straight down; frames 9-11 hold the low finish. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spiked mace stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s1: Tiger fury. Frames 1-6 he pulls the mace in to his chest and curls into a deep crouch; frame 8 he pushes off the ground, throws the arms and mace wide open and thrusts the chest out with a roar; frames 9-12 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spiked mace stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.c4: Ground smash. The heavy weapon is heaved up over the head with both hands and brought straight down into the ground in front; the body drops with it; a long hold low.
actions.c5: Swing and smash. A wide level swing from the right across the front, carried round and up, then straight down onto the target; a long hold low.

notes: 2026-11-19. 평타 b1(짧게 찍기) → a3(올려치기) → b3(크게 돌려 내려찍기), 전법 s1(호치). 철퇴 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px).
